<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rebounding Smite](/Feats.aspx?ID=4695) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 120

**Prerequisites**
[Channel Smite](/Feats.aspx?ID=4655)

**Trigger**
You miss with your Strike during Channel Smite

</column>

---

The energy from your smite persists for a moment, allowing you to pass it to a new target. Cast the 1-action version of the harm or heal spell you expended, targeting a creature other than the target of your Strike.
name: Rebounding Smite
